=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text dig "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
text bs " (base "
text eqs "): digit sum "
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emitc writes the single byte c
fn emitc c uchar to void
b = new uchar 1 c
emit b
end
note emitb writes n in base b (2..36); a ulong has at most 64 digits in base 2
fn emitb n ulong b ulong to void
buf = new uchar 64 0
k = ulong 0
v = n
while true bound 64
put buf k get dig rem v b
k = add k 1
v = div v b
if eq v 0
break
end
end
for i ulong k
emitc get buf sub sub k 1 i
end
end
fn dsum n ulong b ulong to ulong
s = ulong 0
v = n
while gt v 0 bound 64
s = add s rem v b
v = div v b
end
ret s
end
fn tell n ulong b ulong to void
emitb n b
emit bs
emitu b
emit eqs
emitu dsum n b
emit nl
end
fn main to int
tell 1 10
tell 1234 10
tell 0xfe 16
tell 0xf0e 16
tell 255 8
tell 18446744073709551615 2
tell 18446744073709551615 36
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
1 (base 10): digit sum 1
1234 (base 10): digit sum 10
fe (base 16): digit sum 29
f0e (base 16): digit sum 29
377 (base 8): digit sum 17
1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111 (base 2): digit sum 64
3w5e11264sgsf (base 36): digit sum 155
</pre>
